newsitem.title: LUXEMBOURG: Court says Spain late to enact pension scheme for officials.
newsitem.headline: Court says Spain late to enact pension scheme for officials.

text.p: The European Court of Justice said on Thursday Spain was late to enact Community rules on pension schemes for Community officials.
The court said Spain had not adopted national measures permitting Community officials from Spain to transfer their pensions rights to the Community pension scheme.
Spain told the court the complexity of the issue had slowed the process but said they had been in constant communication with the Commission over the issue.

The court maintained its position that member states may not plead provisions, practices or circumstances existing in its internal legal system to justify a failure to comply with Community obligations.
